thread:
maya.recruiter: Heads up — candidate for IC4 (senior eng) negotiating. Needs: base at band L4, but manager requested temporary M1 uplift for 9 months, sign-on of $12,000, and alignment of equity cliff to payroll start. Candidate wants to start remote 2024-06-01 on project ramp; payroll earliest 2024-07-01 due to immigration. Can we do split payments and tweak vesting cliff to 1 month post-payroll?
omar.peopleops: Quick Q: when you say "temporary M1 uplift" do you mean bump permanent base or an interim adjustment listed in offer as a time-limited stipend? Routing differs.
jess.hiringmgr: Interim adjustment only. Base remains L4. We can offer a 9-month uplift in monthly pay (taxed) plus sign-on. Candidate is a counteroffer risk.
liam.finance: FYI policy: time-limited salary uplifts must be documented and expire automatically; sign-on > $10k requires CFO + Comp Committee sign-off. For cross-border early start, payroll cannot process before immigration clearance; pre-pay options limited.
maya.recruiter: Also equity ask: candidate wants cliff moved from 12 months to 1 month so first vest event happens early. Is that doable?
omar.peopleops: Changing standard cliff is a high bar — legal + comp team typically deny 1-month cliff for IC roles. We can propose a one-time RSU grant with accelerated first tranche vest at 3 months as a compromise. I'll loop Legal and Comp.
jess.hiringmgr: 3 months accelerated tranche is acceptable to candidate. Need to confirm repayment language if they leave <12 months.
legal-bot: Reminder: any deviation from standard equity docs needs Legal stamp. Early vesting language must include clawback/repayment provisions and board-approved OD amendment if > standard thresholds.
liam.finance: Routing plan: I'll prepare a comp-exception packet for the committee: role, permanent base L4, temporary uplift (9mo) summary, sign-on $12k, proposed equity acceleration (one-time tranche at 3mo). Tagging Omar and Legal. CFO will need to approve sign-on.
omar.peopleops: Thanks Liam. Also note benefits eligibility follows payroll date (07-01). If candidate starts remote earlier, we should make offer language explicit: "work may commence prior to payroll onboarding; benefits and equity effective as of payroll start date unless otherwise specified."
maya.recruiter: Candidate prefers partial sign-on in two tranches: $6k upon payroll start (07-01) and $6k after 3 months of service. Would that help approvals?
liam.finance: Splitting sign-on reduces upfront cash risk and aligns with retention goals — finance + comp committee like that. We'll propose $6k @ payroll, $6k @ 3mo cliff. CFO still required.
jess.hiringmgr: Please also include clause that temporary uplift terminates automatically after 9 months and does not change band placement.
omar.peopleops: Will add automated expiry clause and repayment terms (pro rata repay if voluntary departure <12 months).
legal-bot: Filing required: legal.review.request (REF-8421) for equity amendment + sign-on structure. Expect 48-72h turnaround.
liam.finance: I'll queue CFO approval and comp-committee (urgent). Can we get candidate to accept offer with conditional language to keep timeline?
maya.recruiter: Sent conditional offer draft: "role L4, temporary compensation uplift for 9 months subject to Comp Committee and CFO approval, sign-on split $6k at payroll + $6k at 3 months, equity acceleration contingent on legal approval. Payroll start 2024-07-01; allowed remote project start 2024-06-01. Benefits & equity effective as of payroll onboarding."
jess.hiringmgr: Good. Candidate verbally agreed to conditional terms and asked for written offer by Friday.
omar.peopleops: I'll submit comp-exception packet now and ping committee for expedited review. Post updates here once we have approvals.
liam.finance: Marking urgent and adding CFO to the ticket. :rocket:
maya.recruiter: Thanks team — will hold candidate loop open and update on acceptance.
